summary: Trashiyangtse district is overwhelmingly forested, covering 992.19 km² (68.4 %) of its area. The remaining land is largely dominated by alpine scrub at 154.60 km² (10.7 %) and meadows at 73.46 km² (5.1 %), with smaller portions of rocky outcrops, snow/glaciers, and other categories. Agricultural land, water bodies, and built‑up areas together account for less than 5 % of the district’s land.
